findings.title: L1-MINOR-3 fix-pass diverged from R1 stated action — diagnostic codepoint value still discarded at both swap_matrix call sites despite the typed-preserving SwapMatrixError::Unsupported variant existing

crates/benten-crypto-suite/src/swap_matrix.rs:1581-1587 (unsupported_codepoint_msg_static helper — still discards codepoint integer; tag-comment 'L1-crypto-r1-3: classified by variant rather than swallowed' acknowledges only partial closure)
findings.evidence: R1's L1-crypto-r1-3 fix_now_action stated: 'Replace the two call sites (swap_matrix.rs:438-440 + 539-541) with `.map_err(SwapMatrixError::Unsupported)` (no helper fn needed; the From impl on `Unsupported` variant handles the conversion directly). Delete the now-unused `unsupported_codepoint_msg_static` helper. Preserves typed-error info end-to-end + simplifies the cipher-suite resolve failure path.' The fix-pass instead retained the helper + retained the call sites + only changed the helper body to classify by variant name (e.g. 'cipher-suite codepoint typed-unsupported' static string). The helper's own docstring (line 1576-1580) acknowledges this: 'The codepoint value itself is not interpolated because the return type is `&'static str` (callers that need the codepoint integer value should consult the `UnsupportedAlgorithm` variant directly via pattern matching, not via the message string).' But the call sites at 438-440 + 539-541 wrap as `SwapMatrixError::CipherSuite(static_str)` which produces a SwapMatrixError variant that carries ONLY the static string and DROPS the UnsupportedAlgorithm value altogether — downstream pattern-matching CANNOT recover the codepoint integer. The `Unsupported(#[from] UnsupportedAlgorithm)` variant at line 793 already exists and DOES preserve the typed-codepoint info perfectly. The original finding's intent (preserve diagnostic info end-to-end + simplify via existing From-impl) is unaddressed; the cosmetic helper-body edit makes a surface-only improvement (variant-class-bearing string) without delivering the structured-error preservation.
findings.fix_now_action: (a) Replace `SwapMatrixError::CipherSuite(unsupported_codepoint_msg_static(&e))` at lines 438-440 + 539-541 with `.map_err(SwapMatrixError::Unsupported)` — this uses the existing From impl on the `Unsupported(#[from] UnsupportedAlgorithm)` variant to preserve full typed-codepoint info downstream. (b) Delete the now-unused `unsupported_codepoint_msg_static` helper at lines 1575-1587. (c) Update the surrounding `Result` type annotations only if needed (the variant addition propagates via `#[from]`). (d) Re-run benten-crypto-suite + benten-engine + benten-caps test suites to verify no downstream depends on the dropped string-classification of CipherSuite('cipher-suite codepoint typed-unsupported'). Total edit: ~6 LOC (matches R1 original estimate).
findings.rationale: Per HARD RULE 12: when a fix-pass for a FIX-NOW finding lands a different action than what the action stated, the original action remains unfulfilled. The diagnostic-info-loss class of bug is exactly the kind the freeze-time audit is intended to close — at v1-beta wire-freeze a downstream consumer matching on `SwapMatrixError::Unsupported { codepoint, .. }` to surface a specific bad-codepoint message has no way to recover the integer value from the current `SwapMatrixError::CipherSuite(&'static str)` carrier. Escalated from R1's MIN to R2's MAJOR because the fix-pass acknowledged the finding + landed an implementation + the implementation does NOT close the surfaced concern (the cosmetic helper-body edit is strictly less than the original finding's diagnostic-info-preservation intent).
